environment.description: Deployed in EKS pod with securityContext dropping CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. The pod runs behind an Istio ingress gateway with an EnvoyFilter applying a Lua script that performs response body inspection and strips any HTML tags found in URL-reflected parameter values before the response reaches the client. The Envoy sidecar's response_body_inspection filter uses a pattern match on the original request query parameters and sanitizes corresponding reflections in the response body by HTML-entity-encoding angle brackets. Additionally, the cluster has a Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate enforcing that all ingress resources must route through the sanitizing proxy.

istio_envoy_filter.name: response-reflection-sanitizer
istio_envoy_filter.lua_script: function envoy_on_response(response_handle) -- extracts query params from original request, finds reflections in response body, HTML-encodes angle brackets in reflected content end
